compose.body:
services:
  app:
    build:
      context: ./projects/lettrebox
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    image: lettrebox:deploy
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      RUST_LOG: ${RUST_LOG:-info}
      RWFW__DATABASE__URL: ${RWFW__DATABASE__URL:-postgres://rwfw:${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}@postgres:5432/lettrebox}
      RWFW__APP__BASE_URL: ${RWFW__APP__BASE_URL:-http://localhost:5000}
      RWFW__MAIL__SMTP_HOST: ${RWFW__MAIL__SMTP_HOST}
      RWFW__MAIL__SMTP_PORT: ${RWFW__MAIL__SMTP_PORT:-587}
      RWFW__MAIL__SMTP_USERNAME: ${RWFW__MAIL__SMTP_USERNAME}
      RWFW__MAIL__SMTP_PASSWORD: ${RWFW__MAIL__SMTP_PASSWORD}
      STRIPE_SECRET_KEY: ${STRIPE_SECRET_KEY:-}
      STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET: ${STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET:-}
    ports:
      - "5000:5000"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "curl", "-fsS", "http://127.0.0.1:5000/"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 40s
    restart: unless-stopped

  postgres:
    image: postgres:16
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: rwfw
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}
      POSTGRES_DB: lettrebox
    volumes:
      - postgres-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U rwfw -d lettrebox"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10
    restart: unless-stopped

volumes:
  postgres-data:

dockerfiles.body:
# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1.7
FROM rust:1-bookworm AS builder
WORKDIR /src
ENV CARGO_TERM_COLOR=always
COPY . .
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/usr/local/cargo/registry \
    --mount=type=cache,target=/src/target \
    cargo build --release --locked --bin lettrebox && \
    cp /src/target/release/lettrebox /usr/local/bin/lettrebox

FROM debian:bookworm-slim AS runtime
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates libssl3 curl && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=builder /usr/local/bin/lettrebox /usr/local/bin/lettrebox
COPY config /app/config
ENV RUST_LOG=info
EXPOSE 5000
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=5s --start-period=40s --retries=5 \
  CMD curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:5000/ || exit 1
CMD ["/usr/local/bin/lettrebox"]

projects.name: lettrebox
risks: Cargo build inside Docker is slow on first run; consider warming the target cache
READMEs point at port 5000 while detector suggested 8080; using README as source of truth

risks.message: SMTP is not provisioned by this compose; Stalwart/SES relay must be reachable via the RWFW__MAIL__SMTP_* env before app boot
First-time cargo build inside Docker downloads the full crate graph; expect a slow initial deploy
Detector suggested port 8080 but the app binds 5000 per README; verify no reverse proxy assumes 8080
Stripe env vars are optional here; billing flows will fail until STRIPE_SECRET_KEY/STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET are provided

summary: Rust axum web app (lettrebox) built via multi-stage Dockerfile and served with a Postgres sidecar via compose. Runtime port 5000 per README (detector's 8080 overridden). SMTP is provisioned externally in prod; compose does not bundle a mail server.
